comments.text: Sort of what I expected was coming, but still truly shocking, exhilarating, and terrifying all at the same time. I was explaining to a friend recently how unintuitive exponential growth truly was and that we just don't come into contact with explosive growth in our normal everyday lives. In the end, I used the analogy of... If you fall off a tall building, the ground rushes towards you ever more quickly - but that's only constant acceleration. To experience exponential growth, jump off a tall building attached to a rocket and accelerate into the ground... well, this is where we seem to be with AI tech now. The future is totally unknown. We're just not equipped to think of exponential growth.

comments.author: @ThePiones
comments.text: Wonder if those 5 guys received the 500 twice...

Can we all pause for a moment and take stock of what has happened in the last 12 months? In 24 days it will be a year since ChatGPT was made available to the general public. And no sooner had we had time to recover (of course it was no revolution for AI people technologically), GPT-4 came along and an absolute AI avalanche from all companies followed, even Canva! :-D
And 12 months later Sam Altman introduces the first versions of AI assistants and agents.
And even though the GPT-3 technology has been around since 2020, it's safe to say that in 12 months, that's 365 days, we've moved from a pretty good text generator to autonomous agents that will be able to perform parts of your workflow for you. THIS IS CRAZY! I'm still waiting for us to hit the ceiling, but maybe there isn't one...
